mapper.select: select u.id as u_id, u.avatarUrl as u_avatarUrl, u.nickname as u_nickname, ru.id as ru_id, ru.nickname as ru_nickname, ar.id, ar.articleId, ar.postUserId, ar.replyId, ar.replyUserId, ar.content, ar.likeCount, ar.state, ar.createTime, ar.updateTime from t_article_reply ar inner join t_user u on ar.postUserId = u.id left join t_user ru on ar.replyUserId = ru.id where ar.articleId = #{articleId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and ar.deleteState = 0 order by ar.createTime desc
mapper.update: update t_article_reply set likeCount = likeCount + 1 where id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} and deleteState = 0
update t_article_reply set likeCount = GREATEST(likeCount - 1, 0) where id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} and deleteState = 0
